title: Offerings for the Temple

questions.question: Why did David invite the people to contribute?
options: Because the work is great, for the palace is not for man but for the LORD God
questions.correctAnswer: Because the work is great, for the palace is not for man but for the LORD God
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:1 (ESV): "...for the work is great, for the palace is not for man but for the LORD God."

questions.question: What did David give from his own treasure?
options: 3,000 talents of gold of Ophir and 7,000 talents of refined silver
questions.correctAnswer: 3,000 talents of gold of Ophir and 7,000 talents of refined silver
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:4 (ESV): "3,000 talents of gold... and 7,000 talents of refined silver..."

questions.question: How did the people offer?
options: Freely and with a whole heart
questions.correctAnswer: Freely and with a whole heart
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:9 (ESV): "Then the people rejoiced because they had given willingly, for with a whole heart they had offered freely..."

questions.question: What belongs to the LORD according to David’s prayer?
options: The greatness and the power and the glory and the victory and the majesty
questions.correctAnswer: The greatness and the power and the glory and the victory and the majesty
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:11 (ESV): "Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the victory and the majesty..."

questions.question: Who was anointed a second time as king?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:22 (ESV): "And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time..."

questions.question: How long did David reign over Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:27 (ESV): "The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years..."

questions.question: Where did David reign for seven years?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:27 (ESV): "He reigned seven years in Hebron..."

questions.question: How did the people respond to Solomon?
At what age did David die?
options: At a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor
questions.correctAnswer: At a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:28 (ESV): "Then he died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor."

questions.question: Who did they anoint as prince and priest?
options: Solomon as prince and Zadok as priest
questions.correctAnswer: Solomon as prince and Zadok as priest
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:22 (ESV): "...and they anointed him as prince for the LORD, and Zadok as priest."

questions.question: What did David ask the LORD to keep forever in the hearts of the people?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:18 (ESV): "O LORD... keep forever such purposes and thoughts in the hearts of your people..."

questions.question: How many talents of silver were given by the leaders?
Where are the acts of King David written?
options: In the Chronicles of Samuel the seer, Nathan the prophet, and Gad the seer
questions.correctAnswer: In the Chronicles of Samuel the seer, Nathan the prophet, and Gad the seer
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:29 (ESV): "...are written in the Chronicles of Samuel the seer... Nathan... Gad..."

questions.question: Upon whose throne did Solomon sit?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:23 (ESV): "Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king..."

questions.question: What did David say regarding their status before God (sojourners)?
options: We are strangers before you and sojourners, as all our fathers were
We are owners of the land
questions.correctAnswer: We are strangers before you and sojourners, as all our fathers were
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:15 (ESV): "For we are strangers before you and sojourners, as all our fathers were..."

key_verse_text: Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the victory and the majesty, for all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, O LORD, and you are exalted as head above all.
